def add_item(item, items=[]):
    items.append(item)
    return items

Explain the bug and show a corrected SQL query, briefly. We need every project, including projects with no open task.
SELECT p.id, COUNT(t.id) AS open_count
FROM projects p LEFT JOIN tasks t ON t.project_id = p.id
WHERE t.status = 'open'
GROUP BY p.id;
